notes:
Single loop, drawn as a tall rectangle whose top and bottom sides fall OUTSIDE the 512x512 crop. Visible inside the frame: the left rail (a straight vertical at x~150 running the full height), the right rail (x~400, carrying resistor 0 '6 ohm' at y~26-115 and inductor 1 '2 H' at y~183-285), and one horizontal rung at y~389 that starts at GND 4 (x~110, drawn rotated with its bars vertical and its stem pointing right), crosses the left rail at (150,389) and ends on the right rail at (401,390) after passing through resistor 3 '3 ohm'.

Net map: '0' = the ground node - GND 4, the whole left rail, the left lead of resistor 3, and the two off-frame leads that the left rail runs to (V-DC 2 and capacitor 5). n1 = the right rail above resistor 0, i.e. resistor 0 top plus the V-DC 2 terminal it reaches off the top of the frame. n2 = the short piece of right rail between resistor 0 and inductor 1. n3 = the right rail below inductor 1: inductor 1 bottom, the right lead of resistor 3 (T-junction at (401,390), verified at 16x - the rung dead-ends there and the rail continues past it), and the capacitor 5 terminal it reaches off the bottom of the frame.

Judgment calls: (a) the crossing of the rung and the left rail at (150,389) carries a clear junction DOT - at 34x the crossing is a filled blob about 7x9 px against 2-3 px line width - so it is a junction, not a crossover; that is what puts GND on the left rail. (b) V-DC 2 (bbox centre y = -105) and capacitor 5 (bbox centre y = 573) are annotated outside the image, so their symbols cannot be traced. Both bboxes sit horizontally (x 239-303 and x 249-290) between the two rails, and the left rail and the right rail both run off the frame edge (to y~8 at the top, y~506 at the bottom) without terminating, so the only reading that closes the loop is: V-DC 2 bridges the two rails across the top (left lead -> left rail = '0', right lead -> right rail above resistor 0 = n1) and capacitor 5 bridges them across the bottom (left lead -> '0', right lead -> n3). Both are listed left-then-right; a human re-checking this circuit should confirm those two off-frame parts against the uncropped sheet. (c) The two isolated full-height verticals at x~8 and x~497 belong to neighbouring circuits on the sheet - they touch nothing in this circuit and no annotated component lies on them, so they are ignored. (d) 2-terminal parts are listed top-then-bottom (resistor 0, inductor 1) or left-then-right (resistor 3, V-DC 2, capacitor 5) as drawn; terminal order does not affect any metric.
